circulating granulocyes from patients with asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) secrete matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) and tissue inhibitors of metalloproteinases in vitro, but that granulocytes isolated from patients with asthma secrete less tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinase 1 (TIMP‐1) than granulocytes from healthy subjects or COPD patients.

granulocytes of COPD patients and asthma patients do not display an enhanced secretion of MMP‐8 and MMP‐9, while granulocytes from the asthmatic subjects have impaired ability to release the MMP‐8 inhibitor TIMP‐1.
